title: Peanut Butter Sandwich
summary: A simple no-cook sandwich. Choose plain peanut butter or add jam, then spread and assemble.

ingredients.name: Jam, only if the cook chooses it

equipment: Butter knife or spoon for spreading

steps.title: Set out the bread
steps.instruction: Place two slices of bread side by side on a plate or clean board. Have your peanut butter ready. Would you like jam, or just peanut butter?
steps.cue: Both slices lie flat with their upper surfaces visible and room to spread. Jam is a cook choice, not an assumed ingredient.

steps.title: Spread the peanut butter
steps.instruction: Put some peanut butter on one slice. Use the back of a spoon or a butter knife to spread it gently across the bread, adding more only if you want it.
steps.cue: Peanut butter covers most of the slice in an even layer, leaving a small border. Look for large bare patches or a thick mound in the middle; avoid pressing hard enough to tear the bread.

steps.title: Add jam if you chose it
steps.instruction: If you chose jam and have it, spread a thin layer on the second slice. Otherwise, leave that slice plain and move on to closing the sandwich.
steps.cue: With jam, the second slice has a thin spread layer rather than a large mound. Without jam, a plain second slice is the intended result. No waiting is needed.

steps.title: Close the sandwich
steps.instruction: Turn the second slice onto the first with any spread facing inward. Line up the edges and press gently with your hand. Leave the sandwich whole for the demo.
steps.cue: The two slices are aligned, the filling sits between them, and gentle pressure keeps it from squeezing out at the edges.

checkpoints.target: The cook's peanut butter is spread across most of one slice in a reasonably even layer with a small border. Large bare patches and a tall central mound have been smoothed out without tearing the bread. Judge visible coverage using the live camera and these text cues; no target photo is supplied.

adjustmentLabels.spread_to_bare_patch: Gently move some spread onto the large bare patch
adjustmentLabels.smooth_mound: Smooth the thick mound toward the uncovered bread
adjustmentLabels.ease_pressure: Use lighter pressure so the bread stays intact
